objective: Generate the first 100 genuinely external ToolScout sessions without paid acquisition, while preserving source-level measurement.
principles: Prioritize useful intent pages over broad brand promotion.
Use one canonical ToolScout URL per asset and track channel/campaign with UTM parameters.
Do not treat owner tests, affiliate applications, or bot activity as acquisition proof.
Prefer communities and posts where the resource directly answers an existing question; avoid spammy link dropping.
Measure external sessions, searches, outbound clicks and monetized clicks separately.

reddit.format: Answer first; link only when materially useful and community rules allow it

newsletter.format: One practical shortlist or comparison per send

seo.format: Intent page + supporting guide + internal links
seo.cadence: Publish/refresh based on opportunity score and observed demand

decisionRules: If a page gets external sessions but low outbound clicks: improve recommendation clarity and CTA placement.
If a page gets outbound clicks but has no active affiliate URL: prioritize the matching affiliate application.
If a page gets impressions but weak CTR: improve title/meta and search intent alignment.
If a topic gets neither impressions nor external traffic after sufficient distribution, deprioritize it rather than mass-producing more pages.
